title: CSS Challenge: Flexbox Layout
description: Build a page with: a nav bar that uses flexbox to put the logo on the left and links on the right, and a section below with at least 2 cards laid out in a row using flexbox.

hints: Add display: flex to nav. Then justify-content: space-between pushes logo left and links right
Add display: flex and gap: 1.5rem to .cards to lay cards in a row
Add flex: 1 to .card so all three cards share the row equally
align-items: center on nav will vertically centre the logo and links

tests.message: Page must have a nav element
Use display: flex at least once
Use justify-content on at least one flex container
Page must have at least 2 elements with class 'card'
Use gap to space out flex items
Use flex: 1 on .card so cards share space equally
